footnotes: CoreWeave recorded a $48M tax benefit in FY2025. Interest & other, net = −$1.2B net interest expense + $33M other income + $27M fair-value gains.

Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment (calculated). Total debt excludes finance leases. Q1–Q3 2025 quarterly revenue from CoreWeave's quarterly reports; they add up to the full-year total.

summary: CoreWeave's revenue grew 2.7 times to $5.1B in 2025, its first year as a public company, as demand for AI computing capacity surged. Revenue backlog reached $66.8B, and active power passed 850 MW.

Heavy depreciation and $1.2B of interest expense on the debt used to build data centers produced a $1.2B net loss. CoreWeave spent $10.3B on equipment, so free cash flow was about −$7.3B, funded mostly by new debt.
highlights: Q4 2025 revenue was $1.6B, 2.1 times a year earlier.
watch: Total debt rose to $21.4B, and interest expense to $1.2B.
Operating income swung to a $46M loss from $324M.
A large share of revenue comes from a few customers.
sources: CoreWeave Q4 and fiscal year 2025 results
